sourceEvidence.text: Athlete came through Latin athleta from Greek athlētēs, a participant in public games or contests. The Greek formation is related to competing for a prize and to athlos, a contest. English later developed the broader idea of someone trained in physical agility or strength. The deeper origin of the Greek contest word is unknown.
